verdicts.reason: Both break the design in the same ways. The windmill, which was the hero icon, has shrunk to a tiny glyph stuck in a bottom row of clipped triangle fragments. The corner triangles have turned into a cramped strip of shards, and the diagonal lines float around without purpose, so the original composition is gone. A is also lopsided, with the headline and strip pushed left and a big empty area on the right. B at least centres the headline and strip on the canvas, so it is slightly less bad.
